pr_title: [Map] Rework interaction (entries, keys, values, extract) of NULL MAPs
pr_body:
This PR fixes #11116 

### OId behavior:
`TYPEOF(MAP_KEYS(NULL::MAP(TEXT, BIGINT)))` -> `NULL`
`TYPEOF(MAP_VALUES(NULL::MAP(TEXT, BIGINT)))` -> `NULL`
`TYPEOF(MAP_ENTRIES(NULL::MAP(TEXT, BIGINT)))` -> `NULL`
`TYPEOF(MAP_EXTRACT(NULL::MAP(TEXT, BIGINT), 'a'))` -> `BIGINT[]`

`TYPEOF(MAP_KEYS(NULL))` -> `NULL`
`TYPEOF(MAP_VALUES(NULL))` -> `NULL`
`TYPEOF(MAP_ENTRIES(NULL))` -> `NULL`
`TYPEOF(MAP_EXTRACT(NULL, 'a'))` -> `Binder Error: MAP_EXTRACT can only operate on MAPs`

### New behavior:
`TYPEOF(MAP_KEYS(NULL::MAP(TEXT, BIGINT)))` -> `VARCHAR[] `
`TYPEOF(MAP_VALUES(NULL::MAP(TEXT, BIGINT)))` -> `BIGINT[]`
`TYPEOF(MAP_ENTRIES(NULL::MAP(TEXT, BIGINT)))` -> `STRUCT("key" VARCHAR, "value" BIGINT)[]`
`TYPEOF(MAP_EXTRACT(NULL::MAP(TEXT, BIGINT), 'a'))` -> `BIGINT[]`

`TYPEOF(MAP_KEYS(NULL))` -> `NULL[]`
`TYPEOF(MAP_VALUES(NULL))` -> `NULL[]`
`TYPEOF(MAP_ENTRIES(NULL))` -> `STRUCT("key" NULL, "value" NULL)[]`
`TYPEOF(MAP_EXTRACT(NULL, 'a'))` -> `NULL[]`

Note:
`MAP_EXTRACT` returns a `<type>[]` and will never return NULL.
If the entry is not present the result is `[]` (empty list)
This behavior originated from Presto behavior when the method was first implemented.

Ideally we change this to `<type>`, returning NULL if the entry is not present, as this matches the behavior of other systems.

This is quite a big change in behavior that will affect every use of `map_extract` and also the shorthand `map_column[...]` so that will be a separate change if we even want to make this breaking change.

issue_context.title: `MAP_KEYS()`, `MAP_VALUES()`, `MAP_ENTRIES()` do not propagate dtypes with NULLs
issue_context.body:
### What happens?

```sql
SELECT TYPEOF(MAP_KEYS(NULL::MAP(TEXT, BIGINT)));
--- gives NULL, should be TEXT[]
SELECT TYPEOF(MAP_VALUES(NULL::MAP(TEXT, BIGINT)));
--- gives NULL, should be BIGINT[]
SELECT TYPEOF(MAP_ENTRIES(NULL::MAP(TEXT, BIGINT)));
--- gives NULL, should be list<struct<key: TEXT, value: BIGINT>>
SELECT TYPEOF(MAP_EXTRACT(NULL::MAP(TEXT, BIGINT), 'a'));
--- gives BIGINT[], as expected
```

### To Reproduce

see above

### OS:

shell.duckdb.org

### DuckDB Version:

0.10.0

### DuckDB Client:

@duckdb/duckdb-wasm@1.28.1-dev166.0

### Full Name:

Nick Crews

### Affiliation:

Ship Creek Group

### Have you tried this on the latest [nightly build](https://duckdb.org/docs/installation/?version=main)?

I have tested with a nightly build

### Have you tried the steps to reproduce? Do they include all relevant data and configuration? Does the issue you report still appear there?

- [X] Yes, I have

```py
>>> con.sql("select MAP_KEYS(CAST(NULL AS MAP<INT, BIGINT>))").show()
+--------------+
|map_keys(NULL)|
+--------------+
|          NULL|
+--------------+
```

```py
>>> con.sql("select MAP_VALUES(CAST(NULL AS MAP<INT, BIGINT>))").show()
+----------------+
|map_values(NULL)|
+----------------+
|            NULL|
+----------------+
```

```py
>>> con.sql("select typeof(MAP_VALUES(CAST(NULL AS MAP<INT, BIGINT>)))").show()
+------------------------+
|typeof(map_values(NULL))|
+------------------------+
|           array<bigint>|
+------------------------+
```

```py
>>> con.sql("select typeof(MAP_VALUES(NULL))").show()
+------------------------+
|typeof(map_values(NULL))|
+------------------------+
|             array<void>|
+------------------------+
```

```py
>>> con.sql("select typeof(MAP_ENTRIES(NULL))").show()
+-------------------------+
|typeof(map_entries(NULL))|
+-------------------------+
|     array<struct<key:...|
+-------------------------+
```

```py
>>> con.sql("select typeof(CAST(NULL AS MAP<INT, BIGINT>)['a'])").show()
+---------------+
|typeof(NULL[a])|
+---------------+
|         bigint|
+---------------+
```

```py
>>> con.sql("select CAST(NULL AS MAP<INT, BIGINT>)['a']").show()
+-------+
|NULL[a]|
+-------+
|   NULL|
+-------+
```
